workouts.name: Running (Moderate Pace)
workouts.description: Steady-state running at a comfortable pace (about 6 mph / 10 km/h). Maintain even breathing throughout. Great for cardiovascular endurance and fat burning.

workouts.name: Running (High Intensity)
workouts.description: Fast-paced run at about 8 mph / 13 km/h. Push yourself but maintain form. Shorter duration due to higher intensity. Excellent for improving speed and VO2 max.

workouts.name: Brisk Walking
workouts.description: Walk at a brisk pace (about 3.5-4 mph). Keep arms swinging naturally. Low impact and suitable for all fitness levels. Great for active recovery days.

workouts.name: Cycling (Outdoor)
workouts.description: Moderate-intensity cycling on flat to gently rolling terrain. Maintain a cadence of 70-90 RPM. Builds leg strength and cardiovascular fitness with low joint impact.

workouts.name: Stationary Bike
workouts.description: Indoor cycling at moderate resistance. Alternate between seated and standing positions every 5 minutes. Good for rainy days or gym sessions.

workouts.name: Jump Rope
workouts.description: Standard two-foot jump rope at moderate pace. Rest 30 seconds every 2 minutes if needed. One of the most efficient calorie-burning exercises. Improves coordination and agility.

workouts.name: Swimming (Freestyle)
workouts.description: Continuous freestyle swimming at a moderate pace. Focus on long, smooth strokes and bilateral breathing. Full-body workout with zero joint impact.

workouts.name: Rowing Machine
workouts.description: Steady rowing at moderate intensity. Drive with legs first, then lean back and pull with arms. Targets back, legs, and core simultaneously.

workouts.name: Stair Climbing
workouts.description: Climb stairs at a steady pace, either real stairs or a stair machine. Focus on pushing through your heels. Excellent for building leg and glute strength.

workouts.name: Elliptical Trainer
workouts.description: Moderate resistance on the elliptical with arms engaged. Keep posture upright and core tight. Low-impact alternative to running that still delivers a solid cardio workout.

workouts.name: Push-ups (Bodyweight)
workouts.description: Perform 4 sets of 15-20 push-ups with 60-second rest between sets. Keep body in a straight line from head to heels. Modify on knees if needed. Targets chest, shoulders, and triceps.

workouts.name: Pull-ups / Chin-ups
workouts.description: Perform 4 sets of 6-10 reps with 90-second rest. Grip bar slightly wider than shoulder width for pull-ups, underhand for chin-ups. Use a resistance band for assistance if needed. Targets back and biceps.

workouts.name: Dumbbell Full Body Workout
workouts.description: Circuit of 5 exercises: goblet squats, dumbbell rows, shoulder press, lunges, and bicep curls. 3 sets of 12 reps each, 45 seconds rest between exercises. Covers all major muscle groups in one session.

workouts.name: Bodyweight Squats
workouts.description: Perform 4 sets of 20 squats with 60-second rest. Feet shoulder-width apart, push hips back and down until thighs are parallel to the floor. Keep chest up and knees tracking over toes. Targets quads, glutes, and hamstrings.

workouts.name: Plank Hold
workouts.description: Hold a forearm plank for 4 rounds of 45-60 seconds with 30-second rest. Keep body in a straight line, engage core, and avoid letting hips sag or pike up. Builds core stability and endurance.

workouts.name: Deadlifts (Barbell)
workouts.description: Perform 4 sets of 8-10 reps with 90-second rest. Hinge at the hips, keep the bar close to your body, and drive through your heels. Maintain a flat back throughout. Targets hamstrings, glutes, lower back, and grip.

workouts.name: Bench Press
workouts.description: Perform 4 sets of 8-10 reps with 90-second rest. Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width. Lower to mid-chest, press up to lockout. Always use a spotter for heavy sets. Targets chest, shoulders, and triceps.

workouts.name: Lunges (Bodyweight)
workouts.description: Perform 3 sets of 12 reps per leg with 60-second rest. Step forward, lower until both knees are at 90 degrees, push back to start. Keep torso upright. Targets quads, glutes, and balance.

workouts.name: HIIT Circuit
workouts.description: High Intensity Interval Training: 30 seconds work, 15 seconds rest for 4 rounds. Exercises: burpees, mountain climbers, jump squats, high knees. Maximum effort during work periods. Burns calories long after the workout ends.

workouts.name: Tabata Training
workouts.description: 4-minute rounds (20 seconds max effort, 10 seconds rest, 8 rounds). Perform 4 different Tabata rounds with 1-minute rest between. Exercises: sprints, push-ups, squat jumps, bicycle crunches. Extremely time-efficient.

workouts.name: Burpees
workouts.description: Perform 5 sets of 10 burpees with 45-second rest. Start standing, drop to push-up position, perform a push-up, jump feet to hands, and explode upward. Full-body conditioning at its most demanding.

workouts.name: Yoga Flow (Vinyasa)
workouts.description: Flowing sequence linking breath to movement. Includes sun salutations, warrior poses, balance poses, and a 5-minute savasana. Improves flexibility, balance, and mental clarity. Good for active recovery.

workouts.name: Stretching Routine
workouts.description: Full-body static stretching: hold each stretch for 30 seconds. Covers hamstrings, quads, hip flexors, shoulders, chest, and back. Essential for recovery and injury prevention. Do after every workout.

workouts.name: Pilates (Core Focus)
workouts.description: Mat-based Pilates focusing on core strength. Exercises: the hundred, roll-ups, single leg stretch, double leg stretch, criss-cross, and teaser. Controlled movements with emphasis on breathing and alignment.

workouts.name: Basketball Game
workouts.description: Full-court basketball game or pickup game. Involves running, jumping, lateral movement, and quick changes of direction. Great for cardio, agility, and coordination while having fun.

workouts.name: Soccer (Football)
workouts.description: Casual or competitive match. Constant movement including jogging, sprinting, and directional changes. Builds endurance, leg strength, and teamwork skills.

workouts.name: Tennis (Singles)
workouts.description: Singles tennis match or rally practice. Involves short sprints, lateral shuffling, and overhead movements. Excellent for agility, hand-eye coordination, and cardiovascular fitness.

workouts.name: Boxing (Heavy Bag)
workouts.description: 3-minute rounds on the heavy bag with 1-minute rest between rounds. Mix jabs, crosses, hooks, and uppercuts. Keep feet moving and hands up. Outstanding stress relief and full-body cardio.

workouts.name: Mountain Climbers
workouts.description: Perform 4 sets of 30 seconds with 30-second rest. Start in push-up position, rapidly alternate driving knees to chest. Keep hips level and core engaged. Targets core, shoulders, and hip flexors while elevating heart rate.

workouts.name: Resistance Band Workout
workouts.description: Full-body circuit using resistance bands: banded squats, lateral walks, bicep curls, tricep extensions, and shoulder pull-aparts. 3 sets of 15 reps each. Portable and joint-friendly. Great for home workouts.
